headline: Executive order extends the life of a council set up to review the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA).
what_it_does: This order appears to keep a FEMA Review Council running longer than first planned. The council reviews how FEMA, the federal agency that helps with disasters, does its work. No summary was provided, so details such as the new end date or any changes to the council's tasks are not known from the title alone.

who_it_affects.how: The agency stays under review by the council for a longer period.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the FEMA Review Council
who_it_affects.how: They continue their work on the council past its earlier end date.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 24, 2026; the effective date is not stated in the available information.
